title: Top-dimensional integer multiplicity currents have an integer-valued L¹_loc density (Lemma A)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, V ⊆ ℝⁿ open and X ∈ 𝒟_n(V) (GeometricCurrentOn V n) integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity X). Let e = (e₁, …, eₙ) be the standard basis of ℝⁿ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) and, for an n-covector α, write α(e) := α(e₁, …, eₙ). Then there is g : ℝⁿ → ℤ such that y ↦ (g(y) : ℝ) is locally Lebesgue-integrable on V (LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => (g y : ℝ)) V volume) and X(ω) = ∫_{ℝⁿ} g(y)·ω(y)(e) dLⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V) (TestFormOn V n).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid n)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V n), 0 < n → IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℤ, LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => (g y : ℝ)) V volume ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, X ω = ∫ y, (g y : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)
